This is pre-0.1.0 and the repository is private until 0.1.0 is verified on a
real Podman host and a real k3s cluster. The MVP is built: the engine, the
editor, the connectors, the importer, the metrics and traces, the Helm chart
and the Quadlet units, each one tried against real services. 0.1.0 is cut by
RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md and not before.
